column1: # Stage-2 manual rewrites of the Llama drafts in eval/data/gold_draft.jsonl.
#   1. Break verbatim vocabulary overlap with the source chunk (synonyms, reordered framing)
#      so retrieval is not scored on string matching.
#   2. Resolve dangling references — several drafts opened with "he"/"our"/"the company"
#      with no antecedent, which no retriever could resolve.
#   3. Add a company/date discriminator where the draft was answerable by boilerplate that
#      recurs across filings (disclosure controls, safe harbour, forward-looking language).
